newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products weak, except slightly firm fuel.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weak, except slightly firm fuel.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday morning, with gasoline and gas oil weaker, while fuel oil made an effort to push higher, dealers said.
Gasoline traded at $188 fob Rotterdam and $185.50 fob ARA in early business, both sold by one trading house, and both very slightly lower than on Tuesday.
Swaps levels were also lower, although bids and offers were wide apart, reflecting future uncertainty. Some saw margins pressured, while others saw continued U.S. demand.
Heating oil were down by around $1 a tonne as IPE July gas oil futures weakened. Premiums were barely changed.
